_comment: Input data of OLSDB028. Every entry of "cases" produces ONE Item Redemption API call (OL59)
and therefore one redemption reference in ITEM_FULFILMENT_STATUS (one OLSITRED Detail group).
Nothing here is hard-coded in the code: edit this file to add / change redemptions.
Placeholders resolved at run time (any string value, at any depth):
{{timestamp}}   -> SvcRq/OLSRq timestamp, format yyyyMMdd HHmmss (execution time)
{{messageNum}}  -> unique 6-character message number of this request
{{msgSqNum}}    -> message sequence number of this request
{{todayYmd}} / {{nowIso}} / {{runId}}
A case may also compute the price fields instead of spelling them out:
"unitPriceInPoints" + "quantity"  -> itmRdmFullPriceInPoints, itmRdmPoolUnitsRequired,
itmRdmQuantityItem, itmRdmReceiveQuantity
An explicit value in the case always wins over the computed one.
Baseline taken from the BA request template (F:\OCBC\OCBC.postman_collection.json, OL59_ItemRedeemp).
Verified on dev 29/09/2026: ReturnCode '00000' => ITEM_FULFILMENT_STATUS row +
cat_catalogue_trans_details row (status 'A') are created by the API itself.
SvcRq.ChannelId is NOT written here: it is resolved from item_price.redemption_channel of the
item (active row, selected by itmRdmRewardCurrency / poolId / priceId) and injected through the
{{channelId}} placeholder. Same for the unit price: itmRdmFullPriceInPoints is computed as
item_price.price_in_point * quantity unless the case sets it explicitly.
Reason: each item can be priced per channel - UG7814 has ENQ1/0VN/12 for MB and HT4/3CC/119,
and sending a channel the item is not priced for is rejected with E5921 (Item Price not found).
Other observed business failures: E5903 (Pool Units + Cash Required do not match Item Price),
E5908 (Item Quantity is below minimum required - use quantity >= 100 for this item).

cases.description: UG7814 x100 (channel + unit price resolved from item_price) -> one issued row
same item, different quantity -> a second reference / Detail record
